main_text.l: Sed quis hæc jam expediat Ænigmata? qui
se prius ex Utroque Ordine mecum una ab his
furoribus subtraxerant, Desertores Parlamen-
ti habiti sunt, & in perpetuum exclusi, qui
vero permanebant, & beneficio Tumultuum
utebantur, hi unici erant Senatores: Con-
tra jam, Locum suum deserentes & profu-
gi secum unà Authoritatem Parlamentariam
auferunt, debacchantur in Tumultus, &
se vi armatâ restituunt, dum qui manent
adhuc in statione sua fixi Hortatores Tumul-
tuum audiunt, libertatisque & Honoris Par-
lamentarii Proditores.
Adeo ultra Leges omnes & Regulas
Vis pollet; dumque magis quid in præsens expe-
diat, homines quàm Conscientiam spectent
& illam Normam Justitiæ immutabilem, fit
plærumque ut dum aliorum Judices sedeant
scipfor[?] maximè condemnent.
Jam Tumultus grande Crimen! jam Au-
thores eorum & Fautores prodigiosæ Auda-
ciæ rei, nuper animo in Parlamentum bene-
volo, & necessarii valde adjutores.
Ita (quod olim narratur de illo Præfule
Germano à forecibus & muribus interemptò)
acris sequitur vindicta & deprehendit eos, qui
se Numero securos, & obsequio in Populum
munitissimos existimabant.
In quos jam Leges nil possunt, Deus pro-
priis ipsorum scelerinbus[?] & manibus etiam cas-
tigabit.
Hoc interim Divinæ Justitiæ opus Ipse

page.notes: Page number 22 is printed at top right. A small stray mark sits under it; it is not text and is left out. The running head ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΑΙΚΗ. is printed at the top of the page. Left edge: small marks and fragments from the neighbouring page and show-through, left out. Doubtful readings: "scipfor" (ends the line before "maximè"; the reading is uncertain), "scelerinbus" (printed form uncertain, possibly sceleribus). "Vtroque" is printed with V and is given as Utroque. The last line "Hoc interim ... Ipse" is followed by the signature and catchword line "L 5 ... maximæ".
